subject: Final bank proof for ApexGate — wire + ACH routing confirmed
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <payments@apexgate.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: finance@apexgate.com
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bank proof + remit layout for Redwood (ApexGate)

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. Per our checklist, please find attached the official bank letter and a sample remittance CSV showing the exact invoice->PO mapping ApexGate will send on the first payout. Key items below: 

- Bank letter: confirms account holder name (ApexGate Inc.), account number, routing (ACH), and the SWIFT/BIC for wire.
- Remit sample: two-line CSV with PO reference in the "invoice_reference" column and structured remit in the "remit_note" (example attached as remit_example.csv).

Questions for Redwood to confirm before we go live: 
1) Can you confirm the exact PO/Invoice field Redwood expects so we match the remit_note?
2) For wires, beneficiary name must match bank letter exactly — does Redwood require any additional beneficiary ID (e.g., vendor_id) on the wire memo?
3) We will send a micro-deposit for ACH verification on Wednesday (expected amounts $0.12 / $0.34). Will that flow to your vendor portal email?

Attached: ApexGate_bank_letter.pdf (PDF, 78KB), remit_example.csv (CSV, 1KB)

Thanks — we want to schedule the first settlement for 9/15 if everything checks.

Best,
Liam O'Connell
Head of Payables
ApexGate Inc.
liam.oconnell@apexgate.com
(415) 555-0183

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <payments@apexgate.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bank proof + remit layout for Redwood (ApexGate)

Hi Liam — thanks for sending this. Quick confirmations below, copying Marissa for PO/invoice mapping details.

1) PO/Invoice field: Redwood's payments pipeline expects a single "invoice_reference" (free text) and an optional structured "po_labels" field. For automatic matching to invoices in our payops, include the PO number in the invoice_reference (e.g., PO-44912). Your sample remit looks fine — if you can place the PO as the first token that makes rules simpler.

2) Wire beneficiary: we only require the beneficiary name and account number to match the bank letter. We also support an optional vendor_id (internal to Redwood) in the wire memo; if you include it we'll map the payment to the vendor automatically. Otherwise our team will reconcile manually.

3) Micro-deposits: yes — please send to payments@vendors.redwood.com. Once we see the micro-deposits we'll confirm the amounts and signal GO for ACH.

Next steps: 
- Marissa will confirm PO labeling for the first run and share the final remit CSV template (cc'd).
- I will kick off finance verification and request the finance team to validate the bank letter.

If everything is green we'll schedule the first remittance for 2026-09-15 as requested.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ApexGate bank proof + remit layout — please verify PO mapping

Jonas — forwarding ApexGate's files. Can you validate that the attached bank letter includes all fields finance needs to complete setup and confirm whether we should ask ApexGate to add an internal vendor_id to the wire memo?

ApexGate's sample remit uses these columns: invoice_reference, amount, remit_note. We usually prefer: invoice_reference, po_number, invoice_date, amount, remit_note. If they can add a dedicated po_number column that will make automated matching trivial.

Also, please confirm ETA on ACH micro-deposit confirmation once payments@vendors.redwood.com receives the test. We want to ensure the first scheduled payout on 9/15 will clear.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior FinOps Partner
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
